crime_df = crime_df.dropna(subset=['crime_rate_value'])
valid_boroughs = set(crime_df['borough'])
n = len(crime_df)  # Number of valid data points

# Step 2: Load and preprocess neighbor data
adj_df = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')
adj_dict = {borough: [] for borough in valid_boroughs}

    neighbor = row['neighbor']
    if borough in valid_boroughs and neighbor in valid_boroughs:
        adj_dict[borough].append(neighbor)
        adj_dict[neighbor].append(borough)

    adj_dict[borough] = list(set(adj_dict[borough]))

    elif gi_star < -1.96:
        results.append(f"{borough} (COLD, Gi*={gi_star:.6f})")

# Step 7: Output results
